QuestInfo.name: Blue Blood
QuestInfo.0: The resurrection of the Black Mage draws near, and Shinsoo and the Empress were Maple World's only hope...
QuestInfo.1: Over the centuries, the imperial bloodline has vanished. However, Shinsoo's powers only work with a true Empress. Is this to be the undoing of Maple World?
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart wants you to stay for a year and help the Empress grow as a leader. Can you make the commitment?
